description: [SỬA 2026-09-19, review Nhóm 40 — xem O_QLKD_24] SỬA BUG grain/driving table — cùng lý do nhánh Inspection: bản trước dùng Penalty Decision Subject Behavior làm driving table (INNER), loại mất mọi đợt kiểm tra không phát hiện vi phạm. Nay driving table đúng = Examination Team Target JOIN Examination Team. Grain = 1 đợt kiểm tra × 1 hành vi vi phạm (nếu có).
etl_logic: FROM examination_team_target JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id AND examination_team.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM' LEFT JOIN pd_subject ON (CASE WHEN examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN examination_team_target.citizen_id ELSE examination_team_target.business_registration_nbr END) = pd_subject.subject_id_nbr AND pd_subject.subject_tp_code = 'ORGANIZATION' LEFT JOIN pd_subject_behavior ON pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_id = pd_subject.pd_subject_id WHERE examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'SECURITIES_COMPANY' AND examination_team_target.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_EXAMINATION_TEAM_TARGET' -> CONCAT(examination_team_target.examination_team_target_code, '_', COALESCE(pd_subject_behavior.pd_subject_behavior_code, 'NOVIOLATION'))

description: Mã CTCK bị kiểm tra — GAP định danh chưa đóng hoàn toàn (xem O_QLKD_24): join theo định danh (CCCD/ĐKKD, xem O_QLKD_13) khi có match Penalty Decision Subject, fallback Team Target.target_reference_id khi không. [SỬA 2026-09-19] Đổi JOIN securities_company (INNER) → LEFT JOIN — cùng lý do nhánh Inspection, tránh loại đợt kiểm tra khi không resolve được sc_code. [SỬA 2026-10-15] Mã số thuế nối qua Atomic `ip_alternative_identification` (src_stm_code = 'SCMS_SC_FIRM_INFO', identification_tp_code = 'TAX_ID') thay cho cột `securities_company.tax_code` không tồn tại.
etl_logic: FROM examination_team_target JOIN examination_team ON examination_team.examination_team_id = examination_team_target.examination_team_id LEFT JOIN pd_subject ON (CASE WHEN examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'INDIVIDUAL' THEN examination_team_target.citizen_id ELSE examination_team_target.business_registration_nbr END) = pd_subject.subject_id_nbr AND pd_subject.subject_tp_code = 'ORGANIZATION' LEFT JOIN ip_alternative_identification sc_tax ON sc_tax.identification_nbr = COALESCE(pd_subject.subject_id_nbr, examination_team_target.target_reference_id) AND sc_tax.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_SC_FIRM_INFO' AND sc_tax.identification_tp_code = 'TAX_ID' LEFT JOIN securities_company ON securities_company.sc_id = sc_tax.ip_id WHERE examination_team_target.target_tp_code = 'SECURITIES_COMPANY' -> securities_company.sc_code

etl_logic: JOIN violation_behavior ON violation_behavior.violation_behavior_id = pd_subject_behavior.violation_behavior_id AND violation_behavior.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_VIOLATION_BEHAVIOR' -> violation_behavior.violation_behavior_nm

description: Hình thức xử phạt bổ sung — chỉ có giá trị nếu Penalty Type của dòng behavior hiện tại thuộc category SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY, else NULL.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'SUPPLEMENTARY_PENALTY' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm

description: Biện pháp khắc phục — chỉ có giá trị nếu Penalty Type của dòng behavior hiện tại thuộc category REMEDIAL_MEASURE, else NULL.
etl_logic: JOIN penalty_type ON penalty_type.penalty_tp_id = pd_subject_behavior.penalty_tp_id AND penalty_type.src_stm_code = 'THANHTRA_PENALTY_TYPE' AND penalty_type.penalty_category_code = 'REMEDIAL_MEASURE' -> penalty_type.penalty_tp_nm

[MỚI 2026-09-19, review Nhóm 40] Ngày sự kiện chuẩn hóa cho cả 3 nhánh UNION — dùng làm PARTITION BY/ORDER BY trên flat table thay vì `issued_dt` (nullable). = COALESCE(Issued Date, Inspection Decision Date).
etl_logic: COALESCE(issued_dt, insp_decision_dt) WHERE issued_dt = pd.issued_dt AND insp_decision_dt = examination_team.decision_dt
